call_context: two-frame call-stack token at each boundary
activation_identity.missing_generation_rule: If no explicit typed generation token is visible, keep cross-boundary generation UNBOUND.

capture_points.role: audio_input selection and InputObject Run dispatch
DDP composite reader and map call if reached
DDP metadata packet and row normalizer

join_rule: Join only by same activation, typed owner pointer, nested call/stack identity, and explicit generation token where available; event order, route name, row index, equal scalars, and matching counts do not close identity.
payload_policy: Pointer/count/status and frame-size scalars only; no table bytes, row bytes, PCM, payload, key/license, or encoded output.
one_attempt_stop: If any path is not reached or a parent-generation token is unavailable, record NOT_REACHED/UNBOUND and stop.
